captions.detailed: This is a 3D model of a standard camera zoom lens. It features a cylindrical alloy barrel in a matte grey finish, capped with a black lens mount and front bezel housing a blue-tinted glass element. Two prominent, ribbed black rings are positioned along the body: a wider zoom ring on the lower section and a narrower focus ring near the top. The zoom ring is designed to rotate on a revolute joint, extending the inner barrel, while the focus ring rotates independently on its own revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a camera zoom lens with an alloy-colored main barrel, a black front bezel with a blue glass lens, and two separate ribbed black control rings. The lower, wider zoom ring and the upper, narrower focus ring should both be modeled on independent revolute joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly representing a camera lens. It builds the static lens barrel using concentric cylinders and boolean subtractions to form the main housing, adding a front glass element with a transparent blue material. The zoom and focus rings are generated by creating ribbed cylindrical profiles—patterning small rectangular cuts or additions circumferentially—and placing them onto separate links. These rings are then connected to the main barrel using revolute joints centered along the main Z-axis.
